title: OpenRTB 2.6 SupplyChain
description: Represents all entities involved in the direct flow of payment for inventory.

complete.description: Flag indicating whether the chain contains all nodes involved in the transaction. 0 = no, 1 = yes.

nodes.description: Array of SupplyChainNode objects in the order of the chain.

ver.description: Version of the supply chain specification in use (e.g., "1.0").

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
